name: Warpline
author: CLVRKE
summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches (add your own in <drive>/Warpline/Patches), 519 factory patches in 11 genres incl. rage, UK garage, DnB and jungle, with search and favourites, a wavetable picker, a generative 16-step arpeggiator, GRAINZ granular FX and a mod matrix with random sources.
